**Type:** implementation slice of the accepted SDK-first/backend-neutral direction; precise API and adapter design remain proposals. Parent: [#1399](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1399), not a reproduced runtime defect.

**Outcome:** shared SDK PM semantics run against an explicitly selected native backend. Packages implement storage primitives/capabilities rather than create/update/claim/restore business rules. Existing filesystem behavior remains the compatibility baseline, not a required emulation protocol.

**Evidence:** [item store](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521/src/core/store/item-store.ts#L1-L43) mixes fs, policy, history and extension orchestration; [list query](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521/src/sdk/query/list.ts#L61-L74) imports store enumeration, metadata caches/indexes, paths and settings; [schema migration](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521/src/sdk/schema-migration.ts#L1-L46) already separates a deterministic planning intent but execution uses filesystem/schema/store helpers. These are extraction seeds, not proof all coupling has been enumerated.

**Work:**

1. Produce a machine-checked inventory rooted in public SDK/CLI/MCP operations, including create/import, read/list/search, update/delete/restore, history/integrity/compaction, relationship/schema/settings/policy/author stores, claims/fencing, snapshots/transactions/recovery journals, extension artifacts and derived indexes. Classify each dependency as PM semantics, authoritative persistence, projection/cache, host configuration, or explicitly filesystem/Git domain behavior. Record direct and transitive dependencies and supported public entrypoints, not only `node:fs` grep matches.
2. Derive the smallest typed persistence ports from that inventory: stable workspace/item identity, revision/conditional commit, coherent enumeration, authoritative state plus audit acknowledgement, transactional/coordinator capabilities, schema/config and retention needs. Names are not prescribed. Keep pure normalization/validation/policy/relationships/query interpretation and hook orchestration upstream. Distinguish commit atomicity from multi-step compensation, and shared-store concurrency from independent-copy reconciliation.
3. Move filesystem mechanisms behind its native implementation incrementally. Maintain the old `pmRoot` client path as compatible selection. A backend-neutral call must not need a dummy `.agents/pm` tree. Keep actual local file/Git operations capability-gated rather than banning all filesystem use from every SDK module.
4. Extend the existing [static SDK boundary gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521/scripts/release/static-quality-gate.mts#L1176-L1225), not a disconnected linter. Existing [SDK-first rules](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#L330-L351) already prohibit CLI/MCP private-core edges; the new boundary is **within the backend-neutral semantic layer**. Cover aliases, re-exports, type imports, dynamic imports and indirect helpers; declare approved native/host boundaries explicitly.

**Acceptance:**

- Every inventory operation has an owner, declared capability and conformance scenario or explicit unsupported outcome; unclassified new persistence dependencies fail CI.
- Existing create and update semantics—including their documented hook differences—remain covered. Stale revision or lost ownership refuses before a self-persisting adapter callback; successful acknowledged item/history state cannot diverge silently.
- Settings work extends #1580; artifact work extends #1565. Existing graph adapters remain projections, not mistaken for authoritative stores.
- A negative-control import/re-export from the semantic layer into native fs implementation fails the boundary gate. Legitimate fs adapters/domain actions still pass.
- Packed public SDK plus CLI/MCP tests preserve author/schema/extensions, errors, budgets, complete pagination and references. Claims about compatibility are bound to tested revisions; no mandatory database/server/default switch.

**Tradeoff:** a short-lived inventory classification is necessary to extract safely, but it must not become a permanent growing bypass allowlist. Avoid forcing provider-specific isolation or durability into one lowest-common-denominator CRUD API.


**Intake:** Targeted all-status issue searches and canonical source records were rechecked on 2026-10-25. Reuse #1399 / `pm-gh1399` as the parent; if a more specific canonical owner already covers this slice, attach it there rather than create a competing PM item. This report is static source evidence at `df5bf4aa4db17b7743b4f6bfddb32098f2cbd521`, not executed backend tests or a claim of a reproduced defect. No deadline, assignee, deployment or backend switch is implied.
